The hyperbola is symmetric about the \(x\)-axis, so its foci lie on the \(x\)-axis. From the grid, the foci are

\[
F_1=(-4,0),\qquad F_2=(4,0).
\]

Thus the base of \(\triangle PF_1F_2\) is

\[
F_1F_2=4-(-4)=8.
\]

The marked point is \(P=(5,4)\), so the height of the triangle from \(P\) to the \(x\)-axis is

\[
|4|=4.
\]

Therefore the area is

\[
\frac12 \cdot 8 \cdot 4=16.
\]

\[
\boxed{16}
\]
